keySentence: Real is what happens when someone truly loves you.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Love takes time. But it is real. The rabbit became real. Real is what happens when someone truly loves you.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The velveteen rabbit started as just a simple toy. But the boy loved him every day without stopping. Real is what happens when someone truly loves you. It takes time and patience but it is worth waiting for. The rabbit became real because of the boy's endless love. True love is the most powerful magic in the whole world.
